props.name: direction
props.description: Colour and icon of the pill and the line; an unknown value reads as `primary`.

props.name: points
props.description: The series as heights, 0 (bottom) to 1 (top). Values outside 0..1 are scaled to the series' own range, like `values`.

props.name: values
props.description: The series in its own unit, scaled to `min`..`max`. Takes precedence over `points`.

props.name: min
props.description: Value at the bottom of the plot (default: the smallest value).

props.name: max
props.description: Value at the top of the plot (default: the largest value).

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown in place of the plot when the series has no finite value.

props.name: animated
props.description: Play the entrance animation (default false). When false, render the final state.

props.name: fill
props.description:
Make the visual fill the box it is given instead of sitting in the gallery preview frame: drops the frame's side padding, stretches on the cross axis and removes the module's `max-w-*` cap. Off by default, so the preview rendering — and every golden — is unchanged.

Turn it on to use a visual as a panel in an app layout, where a centred, capped card gives mismatched widths and edges from one cell to the next.
